item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated chat): Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md` in the repository root. Preserve the documented API exactly, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only, so extend them to cover the spec's error and boundary cases. Use the Python standard library only. Commit the work on the item's branch with a clear commit message. Acceptance criteria: every API item and error/boundary case in SPEC.md is implemented and has a test; the full test suite passes; no new dependencies; functions stay under 60 lines and validate inputs at the boundary, raising the errors the spec names rather than hiding failures.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

evidence.caption: Unit test run on the committed tree (after); before the change every retry_delay call raised NotImplementedError (stub, read from source, not run)

pr.body: Files: retry_budget.py (retry_delay, _require_int, _backoff), test_retry_budget.py (validation, attempt limit, backoff shape, Retry-After, budget edges). Approach: validate all args as built-in int before any exhausted return; backoff shortcut when shift >= cap.bit_length() returns cap (sound for base >= 1; zero base returns 0). Checks: unittest 23/23 OK on c82a6c7 tree; reviewer 200k-case randomized comparison vs reference, no blocking findings. Assumptions: wrong types raise ValueError as the spec says (not TypeError). Limits: no before-run of tests captured; no linter configured.
pr.summary: made retry_delay follow SPEC.md. now validates all int args, caps backoff, honours Retry-After floor, enforces strict budget. before: stub raised NotImplementedError; now: full spec behaviour with 23 tests passing.
pr.title: Implement retry_delay per SPEC.md with validation and tests

risk.why: Pure function, no I/O, clock, concurrency, security or migration. Behaviour change is only the new implementation replacing a stub, plus tests. Tests 23/23 pass; reviewer PASS with no findings and confirmed low risk.
